Final exam B (all units)期末模拟卷 B（全部单元）

Covers all nine units at the same level as Final A, with different questions. Work on paper; a scientific or graphing calculator in DEGREE mode is allowed, and a TVM solver may be used for finance. Multiple choice is 1 mark each; written questions show the marks, with part marks for correct steps.覆盖全部九个单元，难度与 A 卷相同，题目不同。在纸上作答，可以用科学计算器或图形计算器（设为角度制 DEG），金融题可以用 TVM 计算器。选择题每题 1 分；解答题分值见题号旁，步骤正确可得部分分。

  1. 2−2a(−3)(−2)b(2)(2)=41​a6b4. The 2 becomes 41​, not 4.2−2a(−3)(−2)b(2)(2)=41​a6b4。系数 2 变成 41​，不是 4。

Q354 marks分L4 Solve会想
A triangular lot has sides 42 m, 55 m and 68 m. A fence post must go in the corner with the sharpest angle. Find the measure of that angle and of the largest angle (nearest tenth), and explain which side each is opposite.一块三角形地的三边为 42 m、55 m、68 m。要在角度最小的那个角落立一根桩。求这个最小角和最大角（精确到 0.1°），并说明它们各对着哪条边。
Smallest angle ≈38.1∘ (opposite 42 m); largest ≈88.0∘ (opposite 68 m)最小角约 38.1∘（对 42 m 的边）；最大角约 88.0∘（对 68 m 的边）
Cosine law for both两个角都用余弦定理
  1. Smallest angle is opposite the shortest side (42): cosθ=2(55)(68)552+682−422​=74805885​⇒θ≈38.1∘.最小角对最短边（42）：cosθ=2(55)(68)552+682−422​=74805885​⇒θ≈38.1∘。
  2. Largest angle opposite 68: cosϕ=2(42)(55)422+552−682​=4620165​⇒ϕ≈88.0∘.最大角对 68：cosϕ=2(42)(55)422+552−682​=4620165​⇒ϕ≈88.0∘。
Cosine law, then sine law先用余弦定理，再用正弦定理
  1. Get the largest angle first: ϕ≈88.0∘ (cosine law as above).先求最大角：ϕ≈88.0∘（同上用余弦定理）。
  2. The other angles are acute, so the sine law is safe: sinθ=6842sin88.0∘​≈0.6173⇒θ≈38.1∘. The third angle is ≈53.9∘; total 180.0∘ ✓.其余两角都是锐角，用正弦定理没有歧义：sinθ=6842sin88.0∘​≈0.6173⇒θ≈38.1∘。第三个角约 53.9∘；总和 180.0∘ ✓。

Q364 marks分L4 Solve会想
You borrow $18000 at 6% per year compounded monthly and can afford $400 per month. How many monthly payments are needed? Justify that 51 payments are not enough.你以年利率 6%、按月复利借 $18000，每月最多能还 $400。需要还多少个月？说明为什么 51 次不够。
52 payments (51 full payments and a smaller final one)52 次（51 次全额，最后一次较少）
TVM solver for N用 TVM 计算器求 N
  1. I% =6, PV =18000, PMT =−400, FV =0, P/Y = C/Y =12. Solve N ≈51.1.I% =6，PV =18000，PMT =−400，FV =0，P/Y = C/Y =12。求得 N ≈51.1。
  2. You cannot make 0.1 of a payment, so it takes 52 payments; the last one is small.不能付 0.1 次，所以需要 52 次；最后一次金额很少。
Present-value formula with two trials用现值公式试两个值
  1. i=0.005. With n=51: PV=400⋅0.0051−(1.005)−51​≈$17967.28<$18000 — 51 payments repay less than the loan.i=0.005。n=51 时：PV=400⋅0.0051−(1.005)−51​≈$17967.28<$18000——51 次还不清。
  2. With n=52: PV≈$18275.90>$18000. So the loan is paid off during the 52nd month.n=52 时：PV≈$18275.90>$18000。所以在第 52 个月还清。
🎯 Goal考查目标
Find how long a loan takes to repay and justify the whole-number answer.求贷款还清所需期数，并说明为什么取整数。
